declarations.name: AuiDataTable
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI DataTable: `<aui-data-table>`.
Two-way: `[(sort)]`, `[(selected)]`, `[(page)]`, `[(pageSize)]`, `[(filters)]`, `[(search)]`, `[(expanded)]`, `[(hiddenColumns)]`, `[(columnOrder)]`, `[(columnWidths)]`, `[(pinnedColumns)]`, `[(collapsedGroups)]`.
Templates: AuiCell, AuiRowDetail, AuiHeader, AuiEmpty, AuiGroupHeader, AuiEditor (`@absoluteui/angular/templates`).

inputs.name: caption
inputs.description: Table caption; the accessible name of the table and its scroll region.

inputs.name: hideCaption
inputs.description: Visually hide the caption (it stays the accessible name).

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Column definitions: id, header, accessor, and optional type, currency, format, render, sortable, compare, align, width, rowHeader; since 0.3.0 also filter, filterOptions, searchable, hideable, resizable, minWidth, maxWidth, exportable, exportValue; since 0.9.0 also aggregate, renderHeader, editable, editor, editOptions, validate, renderEditor.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: All rows (client mode) or the current page (server mode).

inputs.name: rowId
inputs.description: Stable, unique, non-empty id per row. Duplicates throw DATA_TABLE_ROW_ID.

inputs.name: isRowSelectable
inputs.description: Rows returning false get a disabled selection input and are skipped by select all and range selection.

inputs.name: pageSizes
inputs.description: Render a 'Rows per page' select in the composed Pagination.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: client filters, sorts, and pages rows locally; server renders rows as the current page and only emits events.

inputs.name: total
inputs.description: Server mode: total rows across all pages (required when paged).

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: aria-busy on the region, an announced 'Loading' status, skeleton rows when empty, otherwise an overlay over existing rows.

inputs.name: emptyMessage
inputs.description: Text shown when there are no rows (also when filters match nothing).

inputs.name: searchable
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Render a labelled search field in a role=search toolbar above the table.

inputs.name: filterRow
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Render the filter row when a visible column has a filter; false keeps filters programmatic.

inputs.name: resizable
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Resize handles (focusable separators) on column headers for pointer drag and arrow keys; a column's resizable overrides it.

inputs.name: renderDetail
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Row detail content; enables a disclosure button per row. Called when a row is first expanded; returned Nodes are consumer-owned, strings are text. Not combinable with virtual.

inputs.name: isRowExpandable
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Rows returning false get no disclosure button.

inputs.name: virtual
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Windowed rendering of the current page inside the scroll region (single-line rows of uniform height); aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex describe the full set.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Virtual mode: initial row height estimate in CSS pixels (16 to 500), replaced by the measured height.

inputs.name: groupBy
inputs.description: Group rows by these column ids, nested in order (since 0.9.0). Client mode only; not with virtual.

inputs.name: renderGroupHeader
inputs.description: Custom group header content (since 0.9.0); decorative, released with releaseNode when dropped.

inputs.name: showTotals
inputs.description: Show the totals row when a column aggregates or totals is set (since 0.9.0).

inputs.name: totals
inputs.description: Server mode: totals by column id, computed by the server (since 0.9.0).

inputs.name: renderEmpty
inputs.description: Custom empty-state content (since 0.9.0); replaces emptyMessage, released with releaseNode when dropped.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides (expand and collapse since 0.3.0).

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: Row selection: radios (single) or checkboxes with select all (multiple).

inputs.name: stickyHeader
inputs.description: Keep the header rows (and the filter row) visible while the scroll region scrolls.

inputs.name: sortCycle
inputs.description: tri-state: ascending, descending, unsorted. bi-state: ascending, descending.

inputs.name: multiSort
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Shift+click or Shift+Enter/Space on a sort button adds the column to the sort (or cycles it in place).

inputs.name: filterDelay
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Milliseconds (0 to 5000) between the last keystroke in a text or number filter or the search field and filtering; Enter, blur, and select/date changes apply immediately.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Messages, number/date formatting, text collation, and case-insensitive matching.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone for datetime columns: formatting and date filters.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Cell padding.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Passed to the composed Pagination (mirrors its chevrons).

models.name: sort
models.description: Current sort; each column must be sortable and appear once. An array (since 0.3.0) sorts by several columns, first entry first.

models.name: page
models.description: Current page, 1-based; clamped to the page count.

models.name: filters
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Active column filters by column id; each filter type must match the column's filter kind (text, number, date, enum). JSON-safe.

models.name: search
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Global search text: every whitespace-separated term must appear in the displayed text of some visible, searchable column (case-insensitive).

models.name: hiddenColumns
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Hidden column ids; at least one column stays visible.

models.name: columnOrder
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Display order by column id; unlisted columns follow in definition order.

models.name: columnWidths
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Border-box column widths in CSS pixels, clamped to each column's minWidth/maxWidth. Any entry switches the table to a fixed layout.

models.name: pinnedColumns
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Sticky columns at the inline start and end edges, outermost first (logical edges, so right-to-left layouts mirror). Pinned columns move to their edge; start pins also pin the selection and disclosure columns.

models.name: expanded
models.description: Since 0.3.0. Expanded row ids (pruned like the selection).

models.name: collapsedGroups
models.description: Collapsed group keys; groups are expanded by default (since 0.9.0).

models.name: pageSize
models.description: Rows per page (1 to 1,000,000); null renders all rows without pagination.

outputs.name: selectionChange
outputs.description: The user changed the selection (row input, select all, or Shift+click range).

outputs.name: filterChange
outputs.description: Since 0.3.0. The user changed a column filter or the global search. The page returns to 1. In server mode load matching rows (read table.getState() for the full query).

outputs.name: columnsChange
outputs.description: Since 0.3.0. The user showed or hid a column (column chooser) or resized one (on release, or per resize key).

outputs.name: expandChange
outputs.description: Since 0.3.0. The user expanded or collapsed a row.

outputs.name: groupToggled
outputs.description: The user expanded or collapsed a group (since 0.9.0).

outputs.name: cellEdit
outputs.description: The user committed an inline edit (since 0.9.0); update rows with value.

properties.name: rowCount
properties.description: Read-only: Since 0.3.0. Rows matching the filters and search across all pages (client mode), or total (server mode).

methods.name: setRows
methods.signature: setRows(rows: readonly Row[], total?: number | undefined): void

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Replace the selection without events. Unknown (client mode) and unselectable ids are dropped.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. JSON-safe snapshot: { version: 1, sort, filters, search, columns: { order, hidden, widths, pinned }, page, pageSize, collapsedGroups (since 0.9.0) }.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Restore a snapshot or any subset of it (omitted parts are unchanged). Validates untrusted input (DATA_TABLE_STATE on malformed structure, state unchanged); unknown column ids and values a column cannot take are dropped. Emits nothing.

methods.name: toCsv
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. RFC 4180 CSV of visible/all/named columns and filtered/page/selected/all rows, formatted or raw values, with formula-injection protection. No side effects.

methods.name: toCsvBlob
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. toCsv() as a text/csv;charset=utf-8 Blob.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Table pattern using a native HTML <table> (not the Grid pattern) with sortable column headers (APG 'Sortable Table' example): header buttons plus aria-sort on the primary sorted column. Since 0.3.0: column resize handles follow the APG Window Splitter pattern (focusable separator with value); row expansion follows the APG Disclosure pattern; the column chooser is an APG Menu Button with menuitemcheckbox items; virtual rows use aria-rowcount/aria-rowindex.

limitations: Plain table semantics, not an ARIA grid: no cell-by-cell arrow-key navigation or cell selection. Inline editing (since 0.9.0) opens one cell editor at a time; editable cells are tab stops.
No column reorder by drag or nested grids (column order is programmatic: columnOrder, setState). Grouping and aggregation (since 0.9.0) run in client mode only and not with virtual.

Pointer resizing needs a drag; the single-pointer alternatives are the keyboard handle (focus it, then arrow keys) and columnWidths/setState. WCAG 2.5.7 conformance of the pointer path relies on those alternatives and is flagged for review.
Select all applies to the current page (every row of it in virtual mode); there is no 'select all N results' affordance. Filters do not change the selection: rows filtered out stay selected.
Shift+click range selection works within the current page only.
Virtual scrolling needs a scroll region with a bounded height (70vh by default) and single-line rows of uniform height; it cannot be combined with renderDetail.
Enum filters in the filter row choose one value; several values (values: [...]) are programmatic and shown as 'n selected'.
Text filters and search are case-insensitive substring matches on the displayed text; accents and punctuation are significant.
Filters and search do not run in server mode; the consumer applies them (aui-filter-change, getState()).
The sticky header sticks within the scroll region; give the region a max-block-size for it to take effect on long tables.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.

declarations.name: AuiDataTableColumnChooser
declarations.description:
Angular binding for DataTableColumnChooser (since 0.3.0):
`<button type="button" [auiDataTableColumnChooser]="table">Columns</button>` where `table` is an
`<aui-data-table #table="auiDataTable">` reference. Options are read once at creation.

inputs.name: auiDataTableColumnChooser
inputs.description: The table whose columns the menu shows and hides: a `#table="auiDataTable"` reference.

inputs.name: menuLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the menu (default "Columns").

inputs.name: placement
inputs.description: Menu position relative to the button.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Passed to the composed Pagination (mirrors its chevrons).

declarations.name: AuiColumn

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Column id; defaults to `field`.

inputs.name: field
inputs.description: Row property shown in the column (when no `accessor` is bound).

inputs.name: header
inputs.description: Header text and the column's accessible name.

inputs.name: accessor
inputs.description: Raw value used for sorting and default rendering (instead of `field`).

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Typed formatting and sorting: text (default), number, currency (needs `currency`), date (PlainDate), datetime (Instant, shown in the configured time zone), or boolean.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.description: ISO 4217 code for `type="currency"`, for example EUR.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Cell text (rendered as text, never HTML); overrides typed formatting.

inputs.name: sortable
inputs.description: Whether users can sort by this column (default true).

inputs.name: compare
inputs.description: Custom comparator (ascending).

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Cell alignment; default end for number and currency columns, otherwise start.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: CSS length: a number followed by px, rem, em, %, or ch.

inputs.name: rowHeader
inputs.description: Render cells as row headers (`th scope="row"`); default: the first column.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Filter kind: text, number, date, or enum (number needs a number or currency column, date a date or datetime column, enum `filterOptions` or a boolean column).

inputs.name: filterOptions
inputs.description: Options of an enum filter (default for boolean columns: Yes / No).

inputs.name: searchable
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Render a labelled search field in a role=search toolbar above the table.

inputs.name: hideable
inputs.description: Whether the column chooser may hide the column (default true).

inputs.name: resizable
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Resize handles (focusable separators) on column headers for pointer drag and arrow keys; a column's resizable overrides it.

inputs.name: minWidth
inputs.description: Minimum resize width in pixels (default 64).

inputs.name: maxWidth
inputs.description: Maximum resize width in pixels (default 960).

inputs.name: exportable
inputs.description: Include the column in CSV exports (default true).

inputs.name: exportValue
inputs.description: CSV cell value; overrides the formatted or raw value.

inputs.name: aggregate
inputs.description: Aggregate shown in group headers and the totals row: sum, avg, min, max, count, or a function of the values and rows.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Inline editing: `editable` (bare attribute) or a function of the row.

inputs.name: editor
inputs.description: Built-in inline editor: text, number, date, select, or checkbox (default from `type`).

inputs.name: editOptions
inputs.description: Choices of the select editor.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Validate an edited value; return a message to keep the editor open with an error.

constants.name: AUI_DATA_TABLE
constants.type: readonly [typeof AuiDataTable, typeof AuiColumn, typeof AuiCell, typeof AuiHeader, typeof AuiRowDetail, typeof AuiEmpty, typeof AuiGroupHeader, typeof AuiEditor]
constants.description: The table, `<aui-column>`, and its templates, for `imports`.
